required_claude_source.result_applied: D_k theorem: for k>=5 and Z_k=e_k(M^TM), ||p_Q||inf <= sqrt(2e) k/(k-4) Z_k^(-1/(2k)), with no row-marginal condition and arbitrary self blocks/affine terms

partner_result.applied_at: Exact conjugate-fiber cap M(u)=1/(2m(u)) and exact formula int m_N^gamma = 2/(gamma+1)[(1-1/N)N^(1-gamma)+1/N]

new_results.statement: An unnormalized local small-ball bound C w(u)^gamma |J| transfers with the same C whenever 0<=w<=1, int w=1 and gamma>=1; the exponent one is sharp for unrestricted fragmented conjugate fibers.

For arbitrary positive cap vector M and arbitrary parameter family of convex TV-lsc output functionals, the supremum over all product laws with marginal caps M equals the supremum over compact finite-fragment variable-cap extreme products, simultaneously over all parameters including affine shifts.

For every fixed k>=5, a target-valid hyperbolic cross form with eigenvalues +/-1 has direct D_k density bound C_k independent of fragment count N, while condition->normalize conjugate fibers->D_k->average produces an exact certificate growing as const(k) N^2.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-UNNORMALIZED-DECOUPLING-OR-KERNEL-LEAKAGE-v1: in every remaining no-pivot/heavy-star branch, take an existing volume/ridge/bank exit before normalized fiber conditioning, or prove a product-preserving kernel-leakage/positive-copy estimate retaining at least one full overlap or subprobability mass power for each independently introduced conditioning variable until reciprocal inversion is complete.
scope_warnings: The D_k conditioning construction refutes only a proof ordering, not D_k and not QFORM.
Uniformity in affine shifts does not by itself justify normalizing thin conditional fibers before averaging.
No moments, bounded supports, fixed fragment counts, log-concavity, post-rotation independence, or law-uniform matrix perturbation continuity are assumed.
